primary_source_findings.evidence: Pinned task_runs.py returns an empty recovery-option tuple unless the TaskRun status is NEEDS_ATTENTION. This confirms that simply suppressing the lifecycle transition that creates NEEDS_ATTENTION can also remove the public recovery-option treatment surface.

Pinned task_runs.py recomputes recovery_options(run_id), indexes by option_id, and rejects an option_id that was not generated from server evidence. A benchmark gate-OFF arm therefore cannot pair with unmodified public recovery unless an equivalent evidence-bound option remains available.
